title: Afterglow
subtitle: Piece the good thoughts back together
intro: What he sees is not one whole picture but memories lighting up layer by layer. Click once and let a little of it come back.
closing: He calls it afterglow. Even now he wants it one more time.

fragments.label: Spring Festival
fragments.line: The couplets by the door are still up; the paste has frozen white.

fragments.label: The gala
fragments.line: Someone on TV is singing an out-of-tune song.

fragments.label: Fireworks
fragments.line: Fireworks burst on the window glass like a scrap of daylight.

fragments.label: Window lights
fragments.line: The windows across the way are lighting up one by one.

fragments.label: Red envelope
fragments.line: The red envelope is pressed under the bowl, its edges soaked through with oil.

fragments.label: A family voice
fragments.line: Someone in the kitchen calls him to eat; he does not answer.
